title: sunset-pathfinder
description: Retire the cartographer-pathfinder writer subagent and replace the implementation loop with a single-writer context-engineering loop: strategic milestone compaction and persisted session state to file. Root node for this proposal's curated map.

title: cartographer-pathfinder agent
description: Single-phase implementation writer subagent (read/bash/edit/write). The agent this proposal sunsets; its phase-writing duties move to the single parent writer.

title: implement skill
description: Phase-by-phase implementation workflow that delegates phase edits to cartographer-pathfinder by default. Primary rewrite target for the single-writer loop.

title: proposal skill
description: Proposal workflow; references pathfinder only indirectly. Minor updates for the new state artifacts and read-only-only subagent posture.

title: plan skill
description: Planning workflow producing plan.md/plan.nodes/plan.edges that the implement loop consumes; phase receipts feed compaction.

title: README.md
description: Top-level docs: Cartographer subagents table, Clean Context Contract, receipts/context-packs, quick-start flow diagrams. Updated to reflect read-only-only subagents and new state artifacts.

title: ADR-0002 auditable subagent handoffs
description: Accepted decision assuming a delegated writer (pathfinder). Must be amended/superseded for the writer-subagent portion by a new ADR.

title: cartographer-tools extension
description: Extension exposing cartographer_index/jsonl/artifacts/validation/session/adr tools. Candidate home for a deterministic compaction/state-validation helper (cartographer-compact).

title: validation_runner.py
description: Deterministic validation receipt writer (.plan/<topic>/receipts.jsonl). Existing basis for phase receipts that become the canonical compaction source of truth.

title: analyze_session.py
description: Session telemetry analyzer; produced the sanitized subagent-reliability evidence (calls/errors/durations/compactions). Useful for measuring context-engineering loop health.

title: manage_jsonl.ts
description: JSONL validate/upsert utility for map/fact/plan artifacts; reusable for validating new state/handoff artifacts.

title: cartographer-auditor agent
description: Read-only semantic gate after deterministic receipts. Retained; remains the post-loop semantic review authority.

title: cartographer-compass agent
description: Read-only scope/dependency/repeated-failure decision advisor. Retained for escalation decisions in the single-writer loop.

title: cartographer-archivist agent
description: Read-only research compressor. Retained as a read-only specialist (isolated exploration returning condensed summaries).

title: state.json (planned, canonical)
description: Canonical current-truth snapshot (JSON, schema-validated): schema_version, current_phase_id, focus, next_action_id (singular), active_task_ids, blocked, known_failures, last_validation_receipt_id, limits. Diffable/patchable; rejects unknown fields.

title: plan.json (planned)
description: Task graph (JSON): phases -> tasks with id, status enum (pending|active|blocked|complete|cancelled|superseded), depends_on. state.current_phase_id/next_action_id must resolve here. Mirrors/derives from the existing plan.nodes/edges graph.

title: working-set.json (planned)
description: Scope control (JSON): mode single_writer; active/read_only/forbidden file entries with reasons (scope enum). Forbidden paths may not overlap allowed write paths. Cheap file-level lease.

title: validation.jsonl (planned)
description: Append-only validation receipts (JSONL): id, ts, command, status enum (unknown|passed|failed|skipped|waived), summary, log_path. Raw logs kept outside context. Aligns with .plan/<topic>/receipts.jsonl.

title: decisions.jsonl (planned)
description: Append-only ADR-lite records (JSONL): id (dec_001), ts, title, status, reason, impact[]. Machine-queryable; optionally mirrored to human ADR Markdown.

title: events.jsonl (planned)
description: Append-only tool/action audit trail (JSONL) with stable event_ids; compactable into state.json. Records mutations performed via the state ACI.

title: handoff.json (planned)
description: Compaction/resumption artifact (JSON): schema_version, created_at, resume_order[], resume_instruction, must_ignore[] (prior chat speculation, generated Markdown). Drives the fixed resumption prompt.

title: config.toml (planned)
description: Stable operating config (TOML, human-edited): [compaction] triggers (trigger_context_percent, require_single_next_action, require_validation_before_audit), per-agent [agents.*] mode/allowed_tools, pathfinder enabled=false.

title: schemas/*.schema.json (planned)
description: JSON Schemas (state/plan/working-set/validation/decision) enforcing shape; paired with cross-file invariant checks. Runnable outside the harness.

title: status.md (planned, generated)
description: Generated, NON-authoritative human-readable view rendered from state.json/validation.jsonl. Marked authoritative:false so the agent never treats it as source of truth.

title: cartographer state ACI (planned)
description: Agent-Computer Interface of semantic state-transition commands (task.start/block/complete, validation.record, decision.accept, working_set.claim/release, phase.advance, compact.generate, handoff.refresh, state validate). Sole write path to canonical state; validates schema + cross-file invariants and appends JSONL evidence atomically. Raw files remain the read path.

title: cartographer compact / compact.generate (planned)
description: Milestone compaction ACI command that folds append-only JSONL history into the state.json snapshot, regenerates handoff.json and status.md, and validates schema + invariants (exactly one active next_action; current_phase_id/next_action_id resolve in plan.json; active working-set files exist; no forbidden/allowed path overlap; unique receipt IDs; completed tasks not active; unknown fields rejected).

title: subagent-reliability proposal (evidence)
description: In-repo sanitized session evidence: 107 subagent calls, 17 errors, ~600s turns, 4 compactions, workers leaving the parent to finish. Empirical motivation.

title: git-worktrees proposal (single-writer safety)
description: Codifies one-topic/one-branch/one-worktree and one-writer-per-worktree safety; supports the single-writer end-state.

title: receipts.jsonl (existing)
description: Existing per-topic validation/fallback receipts. Extended as canonical phase-receipt source for compaction.

title: context-packs.jsonl (existing)
description: Existing compact handoff context records. Reused to seed orient/resumption reads.
